$comment: Committed brand configuration. Hooks run in bash on every platform (Git Bash on Windows) through run-hook.py from the repo root; the interpreter is python3, or python where python3 is the Windows Store stub. The permission rules and mount-guard keep the pinned method mount brain-system/ read-only. The brain is shared through git (see /save-brain). Personal overrides belong in settings.local.json. The env caps (spawn depth 1, five subagents at once) come from brain-system/system/agent-teams.md, section 8.

hooks.command: PY=python3; "$PY" -c 'import sys' >/dev/null 2>&1 || PY=python; "$PY" -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, runpy; r = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True); p = Path(r.stdout.strip()) / '.claude/hooks/run-hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__') if r.returncode == 0 and p.is_file() else None" session-start
